description: This file defines the TaskWorker class, which provides static utility methods for processing order-related tasks, such as retrieving customer names, status descriptions, and role descriptions within the OFBiz order processing framework.

classes.name: TaskWorker
classes.description: A utility class with static methods to handle order task-related information such as customer names, status, and roles.

methods.name: getCustomerName
methods.description: Constructs and returns the customer's name in 'LastName, FirstName' format, or an empty string if the last name is not available.

methods.name: getPrettyStatus
methods.description: Returns a human-readable status string based on the current status ID, defaulting to '?' if unmapped.

methods.name: getRoleDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description of a role type associated with the order task; defaults to role type ID if entity retrieval fails.
